name: EZ Bar Incline Triceps Extension
steps: Recline on a moderately inclined bench with your feet planted and hold the EZ bar above your shoulders with a close overhand grip.
Keep your upper arms angled slightly behind vertical to maintain steady triceps tension.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head within a comfortable range.
Contract your triceps to extend your elbows and raise the bar smoothly back to lockout.
tips: Keep your elbows tucked in rather than flaring them out to the sides.
Avoid arching your lower back off the bench as the bar lowers behind your head.
